description: Change a saved Beacon: name, description, tags, default_date_window, status (active or archived), stream_ids, source_channel_ids, topic_filters, manifest_config_patch (merged by key; it can hold exclude_source_channel_ids, exclude_media_formats and exclude_title_terms, headline phrases to drop), natural_language_intent, prompt_text, visibility, entity_filters (saved only; never applied when a Beacon runs). Ask the user before you change streams, channels, filters or status. A change to default_date_window alone needs no new yes when the user asked for recurring updates. Read the Beacon with synorb-beacons(beacon_id), then pass its revision as expected_revision. dry_run (default true) returns a before/after diff and writes nothing; set dry_run=false after the user says yes, or for a window-only change. Adding scope needs allow_widening=true. Starter Beacons keep surface_ids. 17-digit Synorb ID values: pass them as JSON strings, never a number. USE THIS WHEN: the user asks to change, rename, re-scope, or turn on or off a saved Beacon. DO NOT USE THIS WHEN: the user has not agreed, or wants a new Beacon; use synorb-save-beacon.

allow_widening.description: True permits wider scope. Default false.
allow_widening.title: Allow Widening

api_key.description: Synorb key; only if the Authorization header is not set. Tool arguments may be logged.
api_key.title: Api Key

dry_run.description: True returns the diff only. Default true.
dry_run.title: Dry Run

entity_filters.description: New full entity-filter list. Saved only, never applied.
entity_filters.title: Entity Filters

manifest_config_patch.description: manifest_config keys to change; merged by key.
manifest_config_patch.title: Manifest Config Patch

status.description: active or archived; blank means no change.
status.title: Status

visibility.description: org, team or private; blank means no change.
visibility.title: Visibility
